interpretation: The production model currently rejects requests and its error message identifies the daily free allocation.

Earlier probes allowlisted only codes 3036 and 3040, so their unknown cause does not establish an unrelated incident.

This direct synthetic probe does not prove the original user's individual request status and does not validate model reply quality.
